title: Special repairs and Civil Maintenance of Lighthouse Tower, Staff Quarters, Compound wall etc at Mallipattinam Lighthouse.
summary: E-tender for special repairs and civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower, staff quarters and compound wall at Mallipattinam Lighthouse, Thanjavur District, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Mallipattinam, Thanjavur District, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Special repairs and civil maintenance of tower, staff quarters, compound wall etc.

scope.item: Special repairs and civil maintenance of lighthouse tower, staff quarters, compound wall etc.

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening; originals up to 11.07.2024 15:00. Tender fee Nil in table although clause 1.1 refers to a tender fee DD 'as per NIT'.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body

Similar works in last seven years: three each >= 40%, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; completed works only; value enhanced at 7% per annum; certificates from officers not below Executive Engineer
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
PAN/ITCC/GST registration; key technical personnel with qualifications and experience
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III), tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), non-blacklisting affidavit, list of relatives in MoPSW/DGLL, Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)

notes: Section I NIT only; no BOQ. Download/bid submission 20.06.2024 15:00 to 11.07.2024 15:00; opening 12.07.2024 15:00. Issued as an item rate tender; later re-tendered as a percentage rate tender per corrigendum dated 09.07.2024 (nid 1663).
